title.zh: 基础设施保护（受保护场所）（第 6 号）命令 2024

completenessNote: 全文，共 4 条；逐字取自新加坡法规在线（SSO）官方打印视图，未改写、未节选。附表 1 篇以 900000+ 序号随同收录。

text.en: 1. This Order is the Infrastructure Protection (Protected Places) (No. 6) Order 2024 and comes into operation on 31 January 2024.

heading.en: Premises declared to be protected places

text.en: 2. The premises described in the second column of the Schedule are declared to be protected places for the purposes of the Act, and the person specified in the first column of that Schedule is designated as the authority of the corresponding protected place.

3.—(1) In the Protected Places (No. 8) Order 2012 (G.N. No. S 453/2012), in the Schedule, delete items (2), (4), (5), (18), (19) and (26).
(2) In the Protected Places (No. 5) Order 2013 (G.N. No. S 306/2013), in the Schedule, delete items (3), (4) and (5).
(3) In the Protected Places (No. 6) Order 2013 (G.N. No. S 307/2013), in the Schedule, delete items (10) and (12).
(4) In the Protected Places (No. 7) Order 2013 (G.N. No. S 308/2013), in the Schedule, delete item (3).
(5) In the Protected Places (No. 9) Order 2013 (G.N. No. S 310/2013), in the Schedule, delete items (2) and (3).
